comparisons.name: today-light
comparisons.description: Top of the Today view, Aqua: the header with Today selected, its divider and the card of switches over the panel material. The gradient behind the panel stands in for the blurred desktop picture. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (segment titles, row labels) and the two glyphs of the rows, which are Apple artwork.

comparisons.name: notifications-light
comparisons.description: Top of the Notifications view, Aqua: the header with Notifications selected, the day heading with its clear button and the start of a notification. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (segment titles, day heading, the notification's text) and the app icon.

comparisons.name: footer-light
comparisons.description: Footer, Aqua: the divider, the button and the gear over the panel material. The capture shows the wider "2 New" button with its blue dot, so the whole button is masked here; footer-dark compares the button. The gear is an original drawing with the measured size, weight and colour, not Apple's glyph.

comparisons.name: footer-dark
comparisons.description: Footer, Dark Aqua: the divider, the Edit button and the gear over the panel material. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (the button's title). The gear is an original drawing with the measured size, weight and colour, not Apple's glyph.

comparisons.name: select-notifications-light
comparisons.description: A click on the second segment selects it and deselects the first, Aqua: the fills of both, as the Notification-Center-Notifications capture shows them, and the Notifications view in place under the header while the Today view is kept mounted and hidden.

pixels.note: selected Notifications segment, measured on the Notifications capture at 3016,92 (spec: notification-center, Segment, selected)
unselected Today segment, measured on the Notifications capture at 2722,92

disc of the day heading's clear button, above its cross, measured (spec: notification-center, Clear button). The Notifications view starts right under the header: the Today view, kept mounted and hidden, takes no room. If it did, the two views would share the height and the heading would be below this crop.
